_aciklama: Single settings file of the kit. Filled in during setup; code constants are read from here. Secrets (keys, tokens) never go here; they go in .env. ekran_metinleri: overrides for on-screen text (keys: chapter, closing, episode, like, subscribe, subscribed, full_video, hello, first_video_ready, setup_test, first_chapter, chain); empty means built-in text for dil (en, tr). ses.tik_kelimeleri: word prefixes that button clicks lock to, e.g. {"abone": ["subscrib"], "begen": ["like"], "zil": ["bell"]}; empty means the default for dil.
